headline: Triveni Turbine COO Sachin Parab to resign in 2026
summary: Triveni Turbine Limited has announced that Chief Operating Officer Sachin Parab will step down from his position. The resignation is scheduled to take effect on October 1, 2026. The company formally notified the NSE of this upcoming leadership change.
why_it_matters: Leadership transition scheduled well in advance with minimal immediate impact.
